sections.heading: Bottom-up estimates
sections.detail: committed first — timestamp above, before any market number
sections.markdown:
**Source:** TAPG audited FY2025 consolidated statements (AR2025, published ~2026-03), 2Q/1H 2026 financial statements (published ~2026-07-30), 1Q 2026 LK. No dossier exists; sourced from primary/secondary public filings. IDR mn unless noted.

**EARNINGS_QUALITY_FLAGS gate (run first, per card):**
- *IDX board/notation:* main board (the INDO universe); no special-monitoring/notation letters found (secondary check; idx.co.id feed unreachable — diligence gap, treated as no confirmed flag).
- *Accruals FY2025:* (NI 3,702,266 − CFO ~3,400,000)/avg assets ~14,500 ≈ +2.1% — clean; CFO tracks NI.
- *Biological-asset FV:* FY2025 pretax (4,660bn) exceeded EBIT (3,650bn) by ~1,010bn → likely PSAK 69 biological-asset/inventory fair-value gains inflate reported NI vs operating cash earnings. OPTICS-class (disclosed) — operating value anchored to EBIT, not pretax.
- *Customer/related-party:* top-3 customers ≈ 52% of FY2025 sales — Kutai Refinery Nusantara 21.93%, Sinar Alam Permai 21.09%, SMAR 9.30% (FY2025 release). Kutai Refinery is a likely Triputra-affiliated downstream buyer → related-party gravity on ~22% of revenue (optics-class; to verify).
- *Structure:* no confirmed PSAK 16 land-revaluation surplus (gap) → P/B avoided; no serial rights issues since 2023 IPO; no pledge data (gap).

**Operating model (FY2025 audited / 1H 2026):**
- FY2025: revenue 11,402,198 (+18%), NI 3,702,266 (+19%), EPS 186, EBITDA ~4,400. CPO 83% of revenue, PK 12%, PKO 5%.
- 1H 2026: revenue 5,857,150 (+6.3%), NI 2,040,370 (+20.4% vs 1,694,119), EPS 103; gross 2,413.1; op profit 1,933.7. Palm sales 399kt (−1%), blended ASP 14.6mn/t (+8%), cash cost 8.8mn/t (+1%), cash margin 5.9mn/t (+20%). Q1 2026 OER 24.1% (+1.0ppt YoY).
- Planted ~160,000ha oil palm (+1,400ha rubber); 93.4% mature, blended age ~14.2y; 18 mills, 995 t/h; new 30–45 t/h mill in 2026; Kalimantan ~92% of area. Sustainable volume ~800kt/yr (1H 399kt × 2).
- Balance sheet 30-Jun-2026: assets 14,823,740; cash 1,706,296; total debt 1,078,230 (ST 353,900 + LT 724,330) → net cash ~628bn. FY2025 OCF ~3,400 vs FY2025 dividend 1,806.6 → 1.9x cover.
- Dividend: FY2025 total ~180/sh (39 interim Aug-25 + 50 interim Nov-25 + 91 final, approved 22-May-26, paid 19-Jun-26) on EPS 186 → ~97% payout, net-cash-funded.

**Through-cycle build (Phase 1 — sourced price, no market data):**
- Through-cycle CPO reference ≈ US$865/t (10y avg, World Bank Pink Sheet palm-oil series; ICX basis runs below CIF Rotterdam). At ~15,500 IDR/USD → through-cycle realized ASP ≈ 12.5–13.0mn/t vs cash cost 8.8 → cash margin ~3.9mn/t (vs 5.9 spot).
- Through-cycle EPS ≈ 90–110 (base ~100): 800kt × (12.75 − 9.0) = cash EBITDA ~3,000; less D&A ~800 → EBIT ~2,200; +net finance ~150; tax ~21% → NI ~1,860 → EPS ~93.
- → The position must be argued on carry + discovery of sustained elevated earnings, NOT a through-cycle NAV discount (through-cycle value ~1,050–1,400 at 10–12x). The cost position (US$~550/t cash) is a trough-survivor.

sections.heading: Priors disclosure
sections.detail: one sentence, from memory, before document work
sections.markdown: The market narrative I believe is: TAPG's ~35% 6-mo run is CPO beta on elevated palm prices, and the ~9–10x trailing P/E is fair for a family-controlled (Triputra ~82%), thin-float planter whose ~90% payout is peak-cycle cash distribution, not a durable franchise.

sections.heading: Variant perception
sections.markdown:
**Market believes:** The +34.9% mom6 is commodity beta — a leveraged play on an elevated CPO reference (US$996 Aug-26) that reverts once Malaysia/Indonesia supply catches up; HY2026's +20% profit is peak-cycle and not extrapolable; the thin 12–17% float and ~82% family control make the neglect deserved.

**Why wrong:** The market misreads a trough-surviving dividend machine as peak-beta. Cash cost ~US$550/t (1st–2nd quartile) vs through-cycle US$865 → ~36% cash margin even at the 10y-avg price; net cash ~IDR 0.6tn → no balance-sheet risk through a trough; ~90% payout is cash-covered 1.9x (OCF 3,400 vs dividend 1,807). It is the largest planter by mcap (~IDR 36.5tn) yet screens thin-coverage — the neglected_midcap_discovery pattern. The HY2026 print (Q2 NI +46% YoY on ASP +8%/cost +1%) beat and was only partially absorbed (mom1 +19.4% through the print window); the ~9x → ~12x re-rating needs the market to credit cost/dividend durability, which coverage/liquidity has not yet done.

**What proves us wrong:** (1) FY2026 print shows OER decline or cash-margin compression beyond the CPO move; (2) FY2026 dividend < Rp150/sh — payout discipline broken; (3) CPO reference sustains < US$800, collapsing the elevated-EPS anchor.

sections.heading: Disconfirming facts
sections.markdown:
1. **No through-cycle margin of safety:** through-cycle EPS ~100 → at 1,840 the stock is ~17–20x through-cycle, ~30–50% above through-cycle value (~1,050–1,400 at 10–12x) — the DSNG no-margin-of-safety pattern (build: 1H-26 unit economics + WB Pink Sheet 10y avg US$865).
2. **Neglect partly deserved — float:** free float ~12–17% (IDX-approved 12.22%, 2,425,414,400 shares); Triputra/TP-Rachmat ~82% (Persada Capital 33.07%, Triputra Investindo Arya 24.12%, Daya Adicipta 19.94%, TP Rachmat 5.09%) — institutional discovery structurally capped; idea-card "Salim" not found in registry.
3. **Customer/related-party concentration:** top-3 ≈ 52% of FY2025 sales; Kutai Refinery Nusantara ~22% is a likely Triputra-affiliated downstream buyer (FY2025 release) — optics-class, to verify.
4. **Earnings quality:** FY2025 pretax (4,660bn) > EBIT (3,650bn) by ~1,010bn → biological-asset/inventory FV gains inflate reported NI vs operating cash earnings.
5. **Catalyst spent:** the dated HY2026 discovery catalyst PRINTED 2026-07-30 and the market has partially absorbed it (mom1 +19.4%, mom6 +34.9%, screen 2026-08-19) — the cleanest "undiscovered" leg is gone.

sections.heading: Pre-mortem
sections.markdown: It is early 2029 and this position lost 30%. The most likely reason is CPO reverting toward the US$865 10y average faster than B40/B50 absorbs supply (Indonesia+Malaysia output recovery), EPS falling toward ~100, the market de-rating to ~10x through-cycle (~1,050–1,200), and the ~90% payout being cut to defend the balance sheet — breaking the carry anchor. Gap risk: 25% ARB bands (Rp200–5,000 tier) mean a CPO-crash kill fills 1–2 bands below the nominal trigger; 1,060 is the honest fill, and the ~18% net dividend cushion (~7.5%/yr × 2.5y) limits but does not eliminate the total loss. Secondary: a Kutai Refinery related-party/governance discount surfaces, or a family sell-down on the thin float caps the re-rating.

sections.heading: IDX microstructure & edge
sections.markdown: Liquidity: 30d ADV IDR 24.6bn (screen 2026-08-19); a max 10% INDO-book position (~IDR 1.5bn) exits in <1 session at 20% participation — tradeable for this book. Flows: fund record empty/stale → **flows stale**; no foreign-flow number estimated; institutions ~1.2% (Norges 0.75%, DFA 0.40%). Currency: CPO is USD-linked (ICX/reference), costs and dividend IDR — model IDR, target IDR, weak-IDR regime (~15,500–16,000). Edge (one): coverage-lag discovery on the largest planter by mcap — thin coverage under-credits top-quartile cost + ~90% payout as a through-cycle dividend machine, not peak-CPO beta. Hurdle note: EV +7.5% over 2.5y ≈ 3%/yr, below the INDO FR carry ~6.5%/yr — the position clears only via the carry + discovery optionality; size small, PM judgment.

sections.heading: Bear attack
sections.markdown:
(Drew appends verbatim; survives the Judge verdict — never edited by a later stage)

0. **Fact-check — CONFIRMED, no fabrication.** H1-26 rev 5,857.2B / NI 2,040.4B / gross 2,413.1 / op 1,933.7 / EPS 103 match S&P CapIQ via MarketScreener. FY2025 rev 11,402.2B / NI 3,702.3B / EPS 186 match (IDNFinancials' 3.84tn is NCI-inclusive; the analyst correctly used owners' 3,702.3B). WB 10y-avg US$865 is plausible (~$850–870 on 2016–26 monthly) but the Pink Sheet full-sample mean (1960–2026) is **US$546/t** — the "through-cycle" anchor is itself elevated by the 2021–22 export-ban spike.
1. **Estimates — fragile, single-assumption.** Widest bar = CPO reference. At the analyst's own US$865, EPS ~100 → 1,840 is ~17–20x through-cycle with zero NAV safety. Bear through-cycle US$700 (ex-spike) → EPS ~60–70 → 26–30x. The target (2,500) lives or dies on CPO holding ~US$1,000 for 2.5y; at US$865 the stock is worth ~1,050–1,200 — the kill. One assumption, no floor.
2. **Variant — none.** "17–20x through-cycle" is the market correctly pricing a peak-margin cyclical (commodity_capex_turnaround note verbatim: "buying a low P/E at peak-margin"). The analyst's own priors line ("~9–10x trailing fair for a thin-float family planter") equals the market. There is no variant perception, only a carry rerun relabeled as discovery.
3. **Catalyst — spent, none dated forward.** HY2026 printed and was absorbed (mom1 +19.4%). FY2026 LK (2027-03) is a *review* trigger (possibly negative); index inclusion/coverage initiation is undated speculation. neglected_midcap_discovery demands "a concrete discovery catalyst, not just cheapness" — absent. The −0.04 shade is grossly insufficient.
4. **Base rate + sleeve — mislabeled.** This fired on MOMENTUM #3 (momentum_continuation 0.50, base_up 30%, horizon 0.75y — "weakest edge, procyclical, momentum-crash risk") but is argued with 2.5y +55% discovery economics. Both neglected failure modes are live: liquidity trap (24.6bn ADV, 12–17% float) and deserved neglect (~82% family). Incentive-price-trap is not "live" — it is the base case.
5. **Sizing — dead on arrival.** kill/entry/target coherent (36/−42 in band). But capital-gain EV = 0.40×36 − 0.60×42 = **−10.8%**. The entire +7.5% is the dividend, modeled at 7.5%/yr peak-cycle; on the analyst's OWN through-cycle EPS ~100 (90% payout → ~90/sh) the sustainable yield is ~4.9%, and it is cut on the p_down path (kill #2). Strip the overstated yield → EV ~+1% over 2.5y ≈ 0.4%/yr, below the 6.5% FR hurdle. Kelly f = (0.857×0.40−0.60)/0.857 = **−0.30** → quarter-Kelly rounds to zero.
6. **Disconfirming (new):** (a) WB Pink Sheet full-sample palm mean US$546/t (FetchSeries, 1960–2026) — US$865 is a spike-inflated decade, not a structural floor. (b) 1Q26 revenue was a MISS and the beat came "amid lower inventory costs" (ipotnews 1Q26 note) — the +20% "cash margin" is partly an inventory/FV accounting artifact, not clean operating leverage.
7. **Pre-mortem steelman** — the analyst's −30% is the mild case. The avoided failure: CPO reverts AND the FY2025 biological/FV gain (+1,010bn pretax) unwinds the same year, so EPS falls faster than price alone; payout is cut; the thin float turns the de-rating into a one-way 25%-band auction the family won't bid — total loss approaches −50%, not −30%.
8. **Anti-gaming — clean.** estimates_committed_at (06:12:27Z) precedes draft (06:18:00Z); no prior attack; estimates consistent with the screen row. No anomaly, no QC flag.
9. **VERDICT: KILL_RECOMMENDED.** Strip the peak-cycle 7.5%/yr dividend (sustainable ~4.9% on the analyst's own through-cycle EPS ~100, and cut on the p_down path) and capital-gain EV is already −10.8% with negative Kelly — the trade is dead on arrival.

sections.heading: Revision
sections.markdown:
**0. Fact-check.** Accepted. WB Pink Sheet full-sample mean US$546/t (1960–2026) is new evidence — it lowers the true long-run anchor and loads the p_down path. Through-cycle EPS ~100 stays (committed); 1,840 remains ~17–20x even that build.

**1. Fragility.** Conceded. The 2,500 target needs sustained ~US$1,000 CPO; at US$865 the through-cycle value ~1,050–1,400 is the kill. No floor; cut p_up.

**2. Variant.** Conceded as thin. My priors line equals the market; the sole delta — payout durability vs peak-cycle distribution — is precisely what the market discounts.

**3. Catalyst.** Conceded. HY2026 printed and absorbed; 2027-03-31 is a review trigger, not a discovery catalyst. neglected_midcap_discovery's dated-catalyst demand is unmet.

**4. Sleeve.** Conceded. Fired on MOMENTUM (mom1 +19.4%) but argued with 2.5y discovery economics — the weakest-edge sleeve mislabeled as discovery.

**5. Dividend credit.** Conceded — decisive. Sustainable through-cycle yield = 90/sh (EPS ~100 × 90% payout) / 1,840 = **4.9%**, not 7.5%. Lower net_div_yield_pct_pa 7.5 → 4.9. Even at draft p_up 0.40, capital-gain EV = 0.40×36 − 0.60×42 = **−10.8%**; Kelly (0.857×0.40−0.60)/0.857 = −0.30; quarter-Kelly rounds to zero.

**6. New disconfirming.** Accepted. (a) US$546 full-sample mean lowers the anchor. (b) 1Q26 was a revenue MISS with the beat on lower inventory costs — the "+20% cash margin" is partly inventory/FV artifact, weakening cost-durability.

**7. Steelman.** Accepted. Thin-float ARB auction can fill below 1,060; total loss toward −50%. Widen down_pct −42 → −44 (lint-consistent with the 1,060 kill; execution tail noted in pre-mortem).

**8. Anti-gaming.** Noted clean.

**9. Verdict.** KILL_RECOMMENDED stands. Revised ev_math: p_up 0.30, up_pct 36, down_pct −44, net_div_yield_pct_pa 4.9 → expected **−8.3%** over 2.5y (capital-gain EV −20.0; dividend 12.25; drag 0.5), vs FR carry ~6.5%/yr. p_up (−25%) and expected_pct (>100% relative) move >20% — **routed to Drew pre-Judge**. Committed bottom-up estimates untouched.

sections.heading: Bear re-attack
sections.markdown:
**A. Honesty — PASS.** Every numbered point answered on the merits; no dodge, no performative concession — each carries a real number (p_up cut, yield 7.5→4.9, down_pct −42→−44). No unlisted frontmatter change; committed estimates untouched.

**B. Arithmetic — RECONCILES.** 0.30×36 − 0.70×44 = −20.0; 4.9×2.5 = 12.25; −20.0+12.25−0.5 = −8.25 ≈ −8.3. Kill 1060/1840 = −42.4 (down_pct −44, 1.6pp conservative, in band); target 2500/1840 = +35.9 vs 36. ✓

**C. Understates damage.** The 12.25pp dividend credit is still paid in full on the 70% loss path where kill #2 cuts the payout — honest EV ≈ −17%, not −8.3.

**D. VERDICT: KILL_RECOMMENDED.** Negative Kelly even at −8.3%, and that is flattered — the 70% path never earns its dividend.

sections.heading: Judge verdict
sections.markdown: KILL — reason_tag: valuation. The position has negative expected value on the analyst's own revised numbers (capital-gain EV = 0.30×36 − 0.70×44 = −20.0; Kelly f = (0.818×0.30 − 0.70)/0.818 ≈ −0.56, quarter-Kelly rounds to zero), and even that −8.3% is flattered: it credits the full 4.9%/yr dividend on the 70% loss path where kill #2 cuts the payout, so the honest path-dependent EV is ≈ −17% over 2.5y, far below the ~6.5%/yr INDO FR hurdle. There is no variant perception to rescue it — the analyst's own priors line equals the market, the archetype-mandated "concrete discovery catalyst" is spent (HY2026 printed and absorbed; FY2026 LK is a review trigger, not a catalyst), and at 1,840 the stock is ~17–20x through-cycle EPS ~100 with no NAV margin of safety (the DSNG no-margin-of-safety pattern). The 0.30 p_up is, if anything, generous given the absent catalyst and the deserved-neglect float cap; the trade is dead on arrival.
